facts.value: Unconditionally forwards the supplied FtMotionId and Fighter_GObj to Fighter_ChangeMotionState with Ft_MF_None, animation start 0.0f, speed 1.0f, blend argument 0.0f, and NULL alternate animation source, then calls ftAnim_8006EBA4. It validates neither input eligibility nor the motion ID. The zero blend argument selects animation-data default blending in the receiver; it does not guarantee zero effective blend duration.
facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's zero-blend interpretation using the actual receiving branch while preserving exact entry behavior.

evidence.why: Complete unconditional entry helper and literal arguments.
Zero anim_blend selects the animation-data byte; -1 selects zero.

facts.value: On each invocation, traverses HSD_GObj_Entities->fighters in next-link order, overwrites the visited prefix of ecb_offset_arr and ft_pos_arr, and sets count to the number visited. An empty list sets count=0 without clearing arrays; stale tail entries and all other track fields remain untouched. The source declares eleven elements per array, but this routine has no capacity check. The item-side head-item caller refreshes Item_804A0CCC and then clears x154.b0; the overlap consumer skips that snapshot while x154.b0 equals 1.
facts.rationale: Refines full-overwrite wording and documents actual boundary, capacity, and refresh protocol without claiming compiled layout.

evidence.why: Only visited indexed fields and count are written; loop lacks bounds guard.
Source-level array capacities, not compiled layout proof.
Consumer flag gate and count-bounded use.
